headline: Cool, clear Sunday on the lake — perfect fall day for first-timers
lede: Sunday, October 18, 2026 brings cool crisp air with a high near 68°F (20°C) and low around 43°F (6°C). Zero rain probability and mostly clear skies make this an ideal day to enjoy Table Rock Lake, a matinee show, or a relaxed stroll along the Branson Landing.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Morning Cruise
featured.where: Table Rock Lake (Notch Lane / Indian Point area)
featured.why: Cooler fall water temperatures often improve the bite for bass and crappie while bright skies create beautiful sightseeing conditions. Book a morning cruise or rent a boat for the best experience.

plan.title: Early lake fishing or sunrise paddle
plan.detail: Cool mornings activate fish near main lake points and protected coves. Or enjoy a peaceful sunrise paddle before the day warms. Verify current lake levels and conditions locally.

plan.title: Matinee show or family attraction
plan.detail: Catch one of the popular afternoon performances on the 76 Strip or explore a family-friendly indoor venue. Comfortable temperatures make outdoor walking enjoyable.

plan.title: Branson Landing fountain show + dinner
plan.detail: End the day at Branson Landing for the spectacular fountain and light show. Pair with lakeside dining. Confirm current showtimes and restaurant hours locally.
